C1353.title: CAC Summons Nvidia Over H20 Chip Backdoor and Vulnerability Risks
C1353.summary: On July 31, 2025, the Cyberspace Administration of China summoned Nvidia and required the company to explain vulnerability and backdoor security risks in H20 computing chips sold to China and submit supporting materials. The action responded to concerns that tracking, positioning, and remote shutdown capabilities could create risks to computing resource security.
